text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Her radar chart is well-balanced. On 
Personality Matrix Chart A, she'd be 
around the upper right.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Tracen Academy is the ultimate 
environment. After all, there's no limit 
to the students I can analyze! And it's 
packed with all kinds of unique Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... She's got such a quirky 
personality...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why analyzing individuality 
is so important. Overlapping character 
traits is an absolute NO...! I have to 
pinpoint my very own niche!
